mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) increases risk of QT prolongation, which valbenazine may potentiate through its own QT-prolonging effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly and maintain normal potassium/magnesium levels; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; consider alternative diuretic or antidyskinetic agent if QT prolongation develops.
